instructions: Choose one ordinary keyboard, left-click or scroll input using the screenshot. Keyboard inputs are held for 3 seconds. Coordinates are normalized: (0, 0) is the upper-left corner and (1, 1) the lower-right corner. Grid clicks use 10 rows and 18 columns: x=(column+0.5)/18, y=(row+0.5)/10. Left-edge targets use x=0.015625 and y=(row+0.5)/14 for rows 0 through 13. Bottom-edge targets use x=(column+0.5)/24 for columns 0 through 23 and y=0.958333. The center target is (0.5, 0.5). The profile describes controls only and provides no game objectives. The number keys 1 through 9 and 0 activate inventory slots 1 through 10 using the native inventory action for the item in that slot. Hovering an inventory item displays its native action label. The native mouse-operated crafting bar uses left clicks to toggle category tabs and pointer hover to select entries; clicking an entry or its native button activates it. The separate keyboard-operated crafting panel uses W/S to select a category, A/D to select an entry, and Space to activate the current selection. In that keyboard panel, a mouse click activates the current selection; moving the pointer does not select another entry.

action.instructions: Select one input. The chosen key combination, left click or scroll is executed as a single action.

up.description: Hold W to move up. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the previous category.

left.description: Hold A to move left. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the previous entry.

down.description: Hold S to move down. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the next category.

right.description: Hold D to move right. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the next entry.

up_left.description: Hold W and A to move diagonally up and left.

up_right.description: Hold W and D to move diagonally up and right.

down_left.description: Hold S and A to move diagonally down and left.

down_right.description: Hold S and D to move diagonally down and right.

context_action.description: Hold Space to perform an available nearby contextual action. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, activates the current selection.

attack.description: Hold F to attack a nearby target.

escape.description: Press Escape to open or close the current menu.

map.description: Press Tab to toggle the map.

confirm.description: Press Return to confirm the selected menu item.

rotate_left.description: Press Q to rotate the camera left.

rotate_right.description: Press E to rotate the camera right.
